chapter: Early string bands and first jobs
title: German musicians, learning at Holy Cross, and the Zalipo rags
summary: Mello says the early players were mostly German, describes learning to read at Holy Cross and faking with small bands, and playing borrowed rags for the comedian Zalipo.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
